FlexHierNodeSummary.name: FlexHierNodeSummary
FlexHierNodeSummary.description: Represents rollup data for a hierarchy node, including direct, child, and total aggregate values.

ChildAggregateCurrencyValue.description: Child aggregate value in the currency format.

ChildAggregateNumberValue.description: Child aggregate value in the number format.

ChildAggregateValue.description: Aggregated value of all child nodes, excluding the node's individual contribution.

FlexibleHierarchyNodeId.description: The hierarchy node associated with this summary.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date when a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date when a user viewed this record.

Name.description: The name of the hierarchy node summary.

NodeCurrencyValue.description: Node value in the currency format.

NodeMeasureType.description: The financial measure or category summarized, such as total account balance or total opportunities.

NodeMeasureUnit.description: Unit for the node measure type, such as currency, percentage, or number. For example, if the measure type is total financial balance, the unit is currency.

NodeNumberValue.description: Node value in the number format.

NodeValue.description: Individual value contributed by the node.

OwnerId.description: The owner of the flexible hierarchy node summary record.

TotalCurrencyValue.description: Total value in the currency format.

TotalNumberValue.description: Total value in the number format.

TotalValue.description: Consolidate total for the node, aggregating individual contributions from all child nodes and the node's direct value. For example, Total Financial Balances at a regional level reflects the sum of all branch balances plus assets held directly by the region.
